name: Lyo.Idempotency
tagline: Shared idempotency store. The same scope, key, and request hash replays the stored result. A different hash does not run the work again.
description: A scope and key claim one in-progress row. API rows do not steal: a crashed in-progress row stays in progress until expires_at or Abandon. The same hash replays a completed or failed response. A different hash is a conflict. Scopes that start with outbox/ are reserved for the outbox.
features: **API keys do not steal.** A crashed in-progress API row stays in progress until expires_at (default 24 hours) or Abandon. Stealing would run the work twice.
**Replay includes failures.** Fail stores the status and body the same way Complete does. A process crash before either call stays in progress.
**Equal to utc now is expired.** After the sweeper marks the row expired, the key can be used again. The sweeper does not expire outbox rows.

examples.title: Claim and finish

sections.title: Recovery
sections.body: API rows use a lease that lasts until expires_at. Complete and Fail require that lease token. A wrong token does not change the row. The in-memory store throws NotSupportedException when a DbTransaction is passed. The Postgres store joins a caller transaction with a savepoint so a unique violation does not abort the caller transaction.
